title: NASA-UAP-D018, Gemini 4 Experiment Debriefing, 1967
doc_notes: This is a NASA Gemini 4 mission debriefing transcript containing reports of unusual visual observations by astronauts. / This document is a collection of NASA Gemini 4 and Gemini 5 mission debriefing transcripts, technical correspondence, and administrative records; no UAP or anomalous encounters are present.

encounters.summary: Astronauts McDivitt and White observed a structure within the airglow layer, a phenomenon never previously reported.
encounters.quote: they saw a structure in the air glow and this is the first time this is reported

encounters.summary: Astronauts observed a meteor entering the earth's atmosphere below them while in orbit.
encounters.quote: They observed meteor going into the earth's atmosphere down below them.
